# Pickleball Platform — AI Navigation Index

This file acts as a structural index and entry point for LLMs, AI coding assistants, and developers to explore the technical state, business logic, and API schemas of the Pickleball Booking Platform.

---

## 1. Documentation Index Directories

*   **Human Developers Index**: Refer to [docs/README.md](docs/README.md) for the central Table of Contents.
*   **Product Layer Index**: Refer to [docs/00-INDEX.md](docs/00-INDEX.md) for high-level business story maps and costing rules intent.
*   **Decisions Log Index**: Refer to [docs/adrs/00-INDEX.md](docs/adrs/00-INDEX.md) for historical ADRs.

---

## 2. Directory Structure Map

All business and technical specifications are structured into domain-based directories inside `docs/`.

| File | Relative Path | Purpose |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Product Specifications** | | |
| Project Overview | [docs/product/01-PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md](docs/product/01-PROJECT-OVERVIEW.md) | Business goals, Nagpur Besa facility (2 courts), MVP vs. Deferred lists. |
| Project Context | [docs/product/02-PROJECT-CONTEXT.md](docs/product/02-PROJECT-CONTEXT.md) | Customer and staff user journeys, roles overview, and contextual scoping rules. |
| Business Logic | [docs/product/03-BUSINESS-LOGIC.md](docs/product/03-BUSINESS-LOGIC.md) | Customer login workflows, onboarding path intents, and refunds logic. |
| UI/UX Specification | [docs/product/04-UI-UX-SPECIFICATION.md](docs/product/04-UI-UX-SPECIFICATION.md) | Design tokens, layouts grids, styling standards, and font guidelines. |
| Costing Analysis | [docs/product/05-COSTING-ANALYSIS.md](docs/product/05-COSTING-ANALYSIS.md) | Monthly/yearly expense estimates (VM, WhatsApp API, domains, SSL). |
| Future Work | [docs/product/06-FUTURE-WORK.md](docs/product/06-FUTURE-WORK.md) | Gamification ideas, loyalty rewards, WebSockets sync, and Redis limits. |
| **Technical Design** | | |
| System Design | [docs/architecture/01-SYSTEM-DESIGN.md](docs/architecture/01-SYSTEM-DESIGN.md) | Topology boundaries, hosting containers (Hetzner + Cloudflare), SSL. |
| Database Schema | [docs/architecture/02-DATABASE-SCHEMA.md](docs/architecture/02-DATABASE-SCHEMA.md) | Table-level business meanings, columns descriptions, and relational prose. |
| Database Model | [docs/architecture/03-DATABASE-MODEL.md](docs/architecture/03-DATABASE-MODEL.md) | Prisma client database mappings, schema index rules, and Mermaid ER diagram. |
| Frontend Design | [docs/architecture/04-FRONTEND.md](docs/architecture/04-FRONTEND.md) | Next.js routing patterns, proxy matchers, and global styling tokens. |
| Backend Design | [docs/architecture/05-BACKEND.md](docs/architecture/05-BACKEND.md) | Express app structure, folder divisions, and middleware execution flow. |
| Business Rules | [docs/architecture/06-BUSINESS-RULES.md](docs/architecture/06-BUSINESS-RULES.md) | Technical pricing waterfalls, slot lock timer limits, and RBAC matrix. |
| Integrations | [docs/architecture/07-INTEGRATIONS.md](docs/architecture/07-INTEGRATIONS.md) | Unified PhonePe API v2 redirected signatures, WhatsApp template parameters. |
| API Specs Index | [docs/architecture/api/00-INDEX.md](docs/architecture/api/00-INDEX.md) | Entry point mapping modular API request/response payloads. |
| **Operations Guides** | | |
| Development Guide | [docs/operations/01-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md](docs/operations/01-DEVELOPMENT-GUIDE.md) | Dev env setup, seed configurations, migrations, and test commands. |
| Infrastructure Setup | [docs/operations/02-INFRASTRUCTURE-SETUP.md](docs/operations/02-INFRASTRUCTURE-SETUP.md) | Hetzner provisioning, Dokploy deployments, and environment keys. |
| Maintenance Rules | [docs/operations/03-MAINTENANCE-RULES.md](docs/operations/03-MAINTENANCE-RULES.md) | Rule governance, documentation triggers checklist, anti-drift rule. |
| Implementation Status | [docs/operations/04-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md](docs/operations/04-IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md) | Matrix tracking implemented vs planned/deferred modules. |
| Active Issues | [docs/operations/05-ACTIVE-ISSUES.md](docs/operations/05-ACTIVE-ISSUES.md) | Logs of active sandbox bugs, runtime warnings, or test issues. |
| Technical Debt | [docs/operations/06-TECHNICAL-DEBT.md](docs/operations/06-TECHNICAL-DEBT.md) | Deferred optimizations, database index stubs, caching debt. |

---

## 3. Core Repository Hierarchy Rules

1. **Codebase (`/server`, `/web`)**: The absolute source of truth for what is actually implemented and running.
2. **Architecture / Design (`/docs/architecture`)**: The source of truth for the codebase's current technical design and data structures.
3. **Product Intent (`/docs/product`)**: The source of truth for target product intent, business requirements, and specifications.
4. **ADRs (`/docs/adrs`)**: The source of truth for historical decisions and technical rationale.
